subject: Onboarding acceptance: throughput & latency runbook, ops roster
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Alice Park <alice.park@glaciertech.com>, GlacierTech SRE <sre@glaciertech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding acceptance: throughput & latency runbook, ops roster

Alice / team —

Thanks again for the sync today. Per our conversation, attached is a concise runbook and the load test plan we propose for the onboarding acceptance window. High level checklist we want to confirm before the runs: 

- Acceptance targets (stable, measured at steady-state):
  - p95 latency <= 280ms for 512-token requests
  - p99 latency <= 520ms
  - Sustained throughput 220 requests/minute per shard (~3.7 rps) for your peak workload mix
  - Error rate < 0.5% (5xx / timeouts)
- Test types: smoke, ramp (10->100->300 concurrent), soak (2 hours at target qps), failure-injection (node preemption)
- Telemetry: we need token-level latency traces, model variant used, route/fallback events, and full KV-cache hit ratios
- Acceptance artifacts: canonical results CSV + raw telemetry dump (we'll host a short retention), and a signed acceptance email from GlacierTech PO

Proposed schedule (all times PDT):
- Mon 06/27 09:00 — smoke + ramp (30m)
- Mon 06/27 10:00 — soak at target throughput (2h)
- Tue 06/28 09:00 — failure injection / fallback exercise (30m)

Please see the attached runbook for step-by-step commands, and the ops roster section that lists who to loop in on test day. We call out a canary model and a fallback variant; if you prefer a different quantization profile let us know.

Attachments: glaciertech-onboard-runbook-v1.xlsx, glaciertech-loadplan-20270627.csv

Next action: can you confirm the run window and whether procurement needs us to schedule the reserved capacity spike? Once you confirm we'll create the test tickets and a shared results folder.

Best,
Tessa
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Tessa / Ben —

We completed the soak and the preliminary artifacts are attached (glaciertech-prelim-results-20270628.json). Quick summary of the metrics:

- 512-token soak (2h steady-state):
  - p50: 85ms, p95: 265ms, p99: 498ms
  - sustained throughput: 230 req/min (3.83 rps)
  - 5xx rate: 0.27%
- 1024-token mini-run (30 min):
  - p95: 405ms, p99: 820ms
  - throughput: 135 req/min
- Observations: KV-cache hit ratio averaged 78% during soak; one small spike in p99 correlated with a transient node preemption (we attached the trace ids). Fallback to ops-v1 triggered twice over the two-hour run as expected; both fallbacks recovered within 12s.

Based on the acceptance targets you sent, GlacierTech signals preliminary acceptance for the onboarding run. We'll review the raw telemetry and sign the formal acceptance doc once procurement confirms billing window alignment.

Thanks for the clear runbook — the team appreciated the step checklist.

-Alice (on behalf of GlacierTech SRE)
